locations.name: Cairn Castle
locations.blurb: The ancient keep in the northwest corner of the walls, restored over the generations. Baron Sand keeps chambers here, though his seat is now at Sand Manor.

locations.name: Royal Compound
locations.blurb: A fortified district around Cairn Castle that takes up nearly a sixth of the walled town. The seneschal's residence, the Crown garrison, and a temple of Kelleth all stand within.

locations.name: Gravenshoal Skerries
locations.blurb: A cluster of jagged rocks off the northwest edge of town, topped by a fortified lighthouse whose ballista covers the approaches to the walls.

locations.name: Town Docks
locations.blurb: Nearly twelve hundred feet of stone quay and eight piers along the western wall, the busiest and most industrious edge of the town.

locations.name: Able & Codd Shipyards
locations.blurb: One of the town's biggest employers, jointly owned by Zachary Able and the gnome Jarmon Codd. Known for sturdy ketches and for repairs that save damaged ships.

locations.name: Cairnellah Fishery
locations.blurb: The processing shoreline just south of the walls, where the daily catch is cleaned, cured, smoked, and sent to market or inland by caravan.

locations.name: Carpenters' & Shipwrights' Guildhall
locations.blurb: A heavy timber and stone hall near the shipyards that sets building standards and allocates timber, with a lively feasthall beside it.

locations.name: Adventurers' Guild, Cairnellah
locations.blurb: A walled hall in the southwest quarter with a training yard and certification trials. Smaller than the great halls of the big cities, but fully equipped.

locations.name: Netwrights' & Mariners' Guildhall
locations.blurb: A broad timber hall between the shipyard docks and the fishery road, representing netmakers, dory crews, salters, smokers, and carters.

locations.name: Red Wake Inn
locations.blurb: A faded red timber-and-stone inn near the working docks, crowded with crews on shore leave and thick with rumor.

locations.name: Parkline Lodge
locations.blurb: A three-story dressed-stone lodge with brass accents and manicured grounds, where contracts and alliances are quietly arranged.

locations.name: The Happy Clam Tavern
locations.blurb: A sturdy tavern with stables just inside the Fishery Gate, across from the permanent market and just south of the airship dock.

locations.name: Wayfarer's Rest Inn
locations.blurb: A broad-fronted inn with a stable yard just inside the southern gate where the Wexford road enters. Kept by an aelfaen proprietor.

locations.name: Blue Whale Inn
locations.blurb: A modest, well-kept inn in the northeast quarter, where the north coastal road meets the road from Bridgeport. Run by a halfling family.

locations.name: Temple of the Joyous Dance
locations.blurb: A broad marble temple of the Eternal Merryn, open to all. Dance is the heart of its worship, and it works as a community center.

locations.name: Shrine of the Broken Coin
locations.blurb: A somber, gothic-looking shrine near the eastern wall, one of the most visited temples in town, dedicated to Bran of the Broken Coin.

locations.name: Sanctum of the Cold Embrace
locations.blurb: A cool, dim temple of blue granite near the western docks, where sailors and fishers leave offerings to the sea before they sail and give thanks when they return.

locations.name: Cloister of the Open Hand
locations.blurb: A walled compound of the Order of the Open Hand a block north of the Wexford Gate, just east of the airship dock, placed deliberately amid the city's noise.

locations.name: Godsfall Artifact
locations.blurb: The restored ruins of an ancient dragon palace, now the town's airship anchorage under a great dome. The ruins predate both aelfaen and humans.

locations.name: Town Office
locations.blurb: A polished brown marble building with brass fittings near the center of town, home to the seneschal's chambers and the town's clerks and records.

locations.name: Runners' & Couriers' Guildhouse
locations.blurb: A busy guildhouse in the south of town, across from the airship dock and beside the Happy Clam Tavern, handling messages and light parcels across Algar.

locations.name: Fishery Gate
locations.blurb: The southernmost armored gate of the coastal defenses, with twin ballista towers. Traffic is mostly locals and those with business for Lord Sand.

locations.name: Shore Road
locations.blurb: A Crown-built stone coastal road running south from the Fishery Gate to Sand Manor, patrolled and lined near town with fisheries and boathouses.

locations.name: Wexford Gate
locations.blurb: A timber gate between two wooden watchtowers, the main landward entry for traffic from the inland road and from Wexford. Crown soldiers inspect all comers.

locations.name: Hot Springs Road
locations.blurb: The hard-packed wagon road southeast from the Wexford Gate, past farmland and the Hot Springs, then through the forest to Wexford.

locations.name: East Gate
locations.blurb: A large, heavily reinforced gate on the Bridgeport Road with ballista platforms and a raised guard walkway. Crown soldiers assess tariffs and check manifests.

locations.name: Bridgeport Road
locations.blurb: A well-traveled wagon road running nearly straight for some eighty miles to Bridgeport, passing the hamlet of Skiff.

locations.name: North Gate
locations.blurb: A lightly fortified gate in the northern timber wall, mirroring the Wexford Gate, serving local traffic to the shore of Godsfall Bay.

locations.name: Castle Gate
locations.blurb: A fortified barbican with twin stone turrets giving direct access to the outer bailey of Cairn Castle. Entry is by invitation only.

locations.name: Bayshore Trail
locations.blurb: A narrow, well-worn horse path that follows the shore of Godsfall Bay for nearly seventy miles to Peregrine Point at the mouth of Pell's Harbor.
